name: Tempest Rider
summary:
Dominate untamed wilderness in the ultimate hover bike racing experience! Push anti-gravity machines to their limits across diverse natural environments that test your racing skills in different ways.

ENVIRONMENTS:
- Scorching Deserts: Navigate treacherous dunes, dodge massive rock formations, and blast through narrow canyons.
- Rugged Mountains: Master hairpin turns along cliff edges and execute perfect jumps across deadly chasms.
- Dense Forests: Weave through tight spaces between ancient trees and disco
